details:
### Overview
Astra Lab Simulator is an interactive 3D space science laboratory designed to make astronomy and astrophysics accessible, engaging, and hands-on for students worldwide. Instead of relying on static textbooks, learners can explore a real-time 3D solar system, manipulate physical laws, and connect directly with live NASA space data.

### Key Features
1. Interactive 3D Solar System: Realistic planetary orbits, axial tilts, and lighting rendered via Three.js and WebGL.
2. Kepler & Newton Physics Lab: Real-time sliders to adjust planetary mass and orbital distance, demonstrating Kepler's laws, Newtonian gravity, and escape velocity calculations.
3. Surface Lookout Mode: Allows learners to "land" on planets and moons to observe the sky, horizon, and solar elevation from a ground-level perspective.
4. 13-Language AI Space Assistant & Voice Control: Built-in AI space tutor with Web Speech API voice commands supporting English, Bengali, Hindi, Arabic, and 9 additional languages.
5. Live NASA APIs & ISS Telemetry: Integrates real-time International Space Station (ISS) tracking, NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD), and Near-Earth Asteroid (NeoWs) feeds.
6. Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer: Gamified interactive challenges and achievement badges to inspire young explorers.
